heading: INT. COMMUNITY THEATRE - GREEN ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. COMMUNITY THEATRE - GREEN ROOM - NIGHT
A windowless closet crammed with costumes, a cracked mirror ringed by bulbs, a coffee maker leaking onto a pile of scripts.

FRANCO (50s, director, silk scarf, three pairs of glasses on his head) paces in front of the mirror reading cue cards while DOT (60s, stage manager, headset, cardigan with a pen in every pocket) mends a lace collar and bites off a thread, BIFF (30s, lead actor, half-dressed in a pirate costume, one boot on) hops across the room searching for the other boot, LUPE (20s, props girl, glitter on her cheeks) sorts a bucket of fake swords by color, and ROMY (teen, ingenue, sequin bodice) crouches in the corner reciting her lines to a stuffed parrot.
Then thirty minutes of panic! Where's my pirate?
units.name: FRANCO

units.text: I'm right here! I can't find my boot!
units.name: BIFF

units.text: Why is it under the coffee machine?
units.name: BIFF

units.text: "Captain, I beg you, do not leave me."
units.name: ROMY

units.text: Romy, honey, say it to the person.
units.name: DOT
